claim: Every evaluated native tactic proposal, including rejected alternatives, is stored as a content-addressed CBOR transition referencing its exact binary input tape and realized duration. Report schema v10 exposes the authenticated emitted-tape digest for direct inspection, and journal projection rejects a mismatched digest.

implementation.retention_scope: all evaluated proposals are recorded; only the winning proposal enters training replay
implementation.compatibility: The workbench continues to read v9 reports and accepts the new v10 report.

cargo_test_native_tactic_route_runner.adversarial_check: journal projection rejects a proposal trace whose emitted-tape digest differs from its stored transition

scope: Repeated exact input can legitimately share a content digest. Seven distinct tape identities across eight proposals reflect one repeated two-tick interaction tape, not missing evidence.
